description: Structured Pydantic schema for CompetitorComparisonAgent output.

startup_position.description: Assessment of the startup's current market position relative to competitors.
startup_position.title: Startup Position

competitive_advantages.description: Key strategic advantages and unique moats held by the startup.
competitive_advantages.title: Competitive Advantages

competitive_weaknesses.description: Key competitive vulnerabilities or gaps relative to established incumbents.
competitive_weaknesses.title: Competitive Weaknesses

feature_comparison.description: High-level comparison points of key feature capabilities vs competitors.
feature_comparison.title: Feature Comparison

technology_comparison.description: Comparison of technological stack, AI depth, and architecture vs competitors.
technology_comparison.title: Technology Comparison

customer_focus_comparison.description: Comparison of target customer segment focus and user alignment vs competitors.
customer_focus_comparison.title: Customer Focus Comparison

pricing_strategy_comparison.description: High-level pricing model and cost structure comparison vs market alternatives.
pricing_strategy_comparison.title: Pricing Strategy Comparison

innovation_comparison.description: Innovation pace and technological novelty comparison vs incumbents.
innovation_comparison.title: Innovation Comparison

market_positioning.description: Strategic positioning statement and value vector relative to existing players.
market_positioning.title: Market Positioning

competitive_gap.description: Unserved market needs or feature voids left open by existing competitors.
competitive_gap.title: Competitive Gap

differentiation_opportunities.description: Clear opportunities for the startup to carve out a distinct competitive position.
differentiation_opportunities.title: Differentiation Opportunities

overall_competitive_score.description: Overall rating score of the startup's competitive strength from 0.0 to 10.0.
overall_competitive_score.title: Overall Competitive Score

confidence_score.description: Confidence score rating strictly between 0.0 and 1.0.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

citations.description: Source URLs backing the claims above, when external research (Tavily/Exa/Zyte) was supplied in the prompt. Optional and defaults empty so this schema stays backward compatible with LLM-only reasoning when no research bundle is available.
citations.title: Citations

title: CompetitorComparison
